A patch that lets you remove any storage location, not only one that several sections share: a target set up for one section, a repository you set up, and the folder a section writes its own backups to.

## ✨ Added

- **Remove any storage location.** Every storage location page has **Remove storage location**, with the same two ways as before: keep the backups there, or delete them first once the window has listed what goes and which entries would lose their only backup. Entries that back up to a removed repository follow their section again, and so does a section default that pointed there. A section's folder can't just go, because every section needs one. So the window asks for the folder the sections move to, each section keeps its folder name under it, and the new folder gets the same checks as a folder typed into the settings. ([#353](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/bombvault/issues/353))
